acceptance.evidence: Stated in the server visualization README and data.json and in the study's daily report and handoff; the underlying receipts were not accessible to this audit.

field_evidence.outcomes: Recomputed from the report's 5,600 embedded slot records; the counts equal the report's group table, CSV and Markdown summary. Receipt check performed: all 5,182 slots that record a receipt (3,982 new native, 1,200 inherited SDK) have the file present with a matching sha256, and its task, harness, lifecycle state, reason and caps agree with the report; the 418 historical and offline-derived slots record no receipt.
field_evidence.metrics: Recomputed from the per-slot metric flags embedded in the report, not re-scored; flags exist only for scored runs, a missing flag stays unknown, and 236 historical scored runs record only full replication.
field_evidence.provenance: Recomputed from each slot's recorded provenance class in the report.
field_evidence.budget: Recorded logical caps copied from report slots for new and inherited SDK runs; they equal the caps in all 5,182 receipts and the harness source configuration; not independent execution measurements; none recorded for historical or offline-derived runs.
field_evidence.thinking: New runs set no thinking override in the frozen plan or harness code. The study's run notes report that the bundled Claude CLI adds adaptive thinking at high effort on the Claude Agent SDK arm; request records were not independently checked. Other runs: not recorded.
field_evidence.harness_version: New native runs: the pinned version constants in the seven stage sources, confirmed by each receipt's hashed SDK identity record (3,982 of 3,982). Inherited SDK runs: identity records match the same versions for 1,199 of 1,200 (one failed before an identity was written). Historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.
field_evidence.route: Receipt-verified: hashed SDK identity records give the requested route, equal to the report's current route model, for 3,182 new native runs and 599 inherited Claude Agent SDK runs. Report-recorded: the 800 new DeepSeek Harness runs use the report's current route model because their identity records no model. Inherited DeepSeek Harness, historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.
field_evidence.run_date: UTC date of each receipt's recorded start time, for the 5,182 runs with a receipt (none finished on a later UTC date); historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.

caveats: This is a descriptive comparison on a fixed 100-task development set; it is not a Challenge leaderboard and is not directly comparable with the Selected_1000 board.
Cells mix four provenance classes: historical and offline-derived DeepAgents metrics, inherited SDK runs and new native runs.
New runs reach all 14 models through an Anthropic Messages-compatible gateway; historical and inherited runs used their own routes.
Equal recorded caps do not mean equal reasoning compute: the Claude Agent SDK arm's CLI is reported to add adaptive thinking, and historical routes, reasoning settings and wall-time budgets differ.
Failed and unknown runs stay in the fixed 100-task denominator and are never relabelled as false; metric flags exist only for scored runs and stay unknown when a reference is unsupported.
Billing and infrastructure failures are not model-capability failures.

field_evidence.outcomes: Verified against the completed final report: 98 scored and two final execution failures; failure attribution is not inferred.
field_evidence.metrics: Counted directly from the completed paired report flags using local-paper-v1, including coefficient-only correctness; failed tasks remain unknown for every metric.
field_evidence.provenance: All 100 task attempts were generated in this new run; historical predictions were not imported.
field_evidence.budget: All 100 task attempts share the frozen protocol caps: six model calls, four tool calls, 32768 output tokens, 1800 seconds and 90 seconds per tool execution.
field_evidence.thinking: The frozen request profile explicitly sets reasoning effort to high.
field_evidence.harness_version: The frozen SDK source hash identifies the v2-observation release and its pinned DeepAgents, LangChain and LangGraph versions.
field_evidence.route: The frozen request profile uses OpenRouter Responses with openai/gpt-5.6-sol and non-streaming responses.
field_evidence.run_date: The completed run and all selected task attempts are dated 2026-10-14 UTC.
